baslik: The Cable That Sheared the Cable Car's Lifeline

sahneler.metin: A full cable car descending from Mount Cermis suddenly fell.
It plunged down the mountainside, and forty two people were killed.
Its cables had overlapped near the first pylon.
The moving cable sheared the support cable.
The cabin dropped about seventy metres.
The heavy carriage fell on top of it.
It remains the deadliest cable car crash in history.
